dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What rooms are there in here?

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: If I were to tell you, you'd get curious, so it might be best if I simply don't.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette's office is just over by the side — this much everyone knows.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: What else? The Maison Gardiennage and the Marechaussee Phantom are also upstairs, so anyone with ill intent will not be getting very far regardless.
